capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Rated pack energy 23 kWh (DOE/INL fact sheet for the 2013 car; Wikipedia says the same pack ran 2012-2016).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Usable 19.6 kWh; EV Database gives the same figure for this pack (search excerpt only).

chemistry.notes: DOE/INL: Lithium-Ion (LMO), LG Chem cells. LMO is not an enum value, so recorded as other.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Nominal system voltage 318.2 V (86 cells in series), the sub-500 V class recorded as 400v.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: The 2012-2016 car has only an automatic active liquid cooling/heating thermal management system (Wikipedia, DOE/INL) and no DC fast charging; no page for this car describes a user or navigation battery preconditioning feature. Not confirmed by an owner's manual. No maker launch of battery preconditioning could be cited; moot for a car with no DC port (dc_max_kw 0), so owner decision requested.

dc_max_kw.notes: No DC fast charging on the 2012-2016 car (Wikipedia: DC fast charging added for 2017).

ac_max_kw.notes: On-board charger 6.6 kW (DOE/INL 2013 car; Green Cars Compare 2012 page agrees). Years compared: 2012-2016, no change documented.
